overview: The paper proposes R1-Code-Interpreter, a framework that trains LLMs to autonomously leverage a Code Interpreter via multi-turn supervised fine-tuning and a novel multi-stage curriculum reinforcement learning (GRPO) guided by measured improvement potential, enabling robust reasoning across diverse tasks.

modules.name: Task Curation and Standardization
modules.description: Curating reasoning and planning tasks from multiple benchmarks, removing duplicates, and standardizing them into a unified format with rule-based correctness evaluation criteria.

modules.name: SFT Trajectory Synthesis
modules.description: Synthesizing multi-turn text/code trajectories for supervised fine-tuning by prompting a teacher model using varied agent strategies and prompt formats, filtering for correct answers, and balancing the dataset.

modules.name: Improvement Potential Measurement and Partitioning
modules.description: Estimating sample improvement potential by running multiple agent variants to sample answers, calculating the empirical correctness rate and potential score, and partitioning samples into curriculum stages based on potential ranges.

modules.name: Prompt and Response Management
modules.description: Designing the head prompt structure for the Code Interpreter model, parsing final answer markers, and extracting code blocks for execution utilizing implicit tagging aligned with the model's natural distribution.

modules.name: Code Execution Sandbox
modules.description: Designing a specialized, CPU-based sandbox environment for code execution to decouple it from GPU gradient computation, managing timeouts, and handling parallel script execution to improve GPU utilization.

modules.name: Code Interpreter Interaction Loop
modules.description: Managing the iterative multi-turn interaction between the LLM and the Code Execution Sandbox, appending execution results to the context, and enforcing stopping conditions based on code call limits or final answer emission.

modules.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning Engine
modules.description: Executing the supervised fine-tuning phase on the synthesized multi-turn trajectories using full-parameter fine-tuning to instill long-chain reasoning and code/text interaction patterns.

modules.name: Reward and Evaluation Design
modules.description: Implementing the composite rule-based reward function combining outcome correctness, format compliance, and efficiency penalties, alongside format normalization and execution-based result extraction for planning tasks.

modules.name: GRPO with Code Interpreter
modules.description: Implementing the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm augmented with the Code Interpreter context, computing within-group advantages, applying policy gradients only to LLM-generated tokens, and enforcing KL divergence regularization.

modules.name: Multi-stage Curriculum Learning Controller
modules.description: Orchestrating the multi-stage GRPO training by progressively loading data partitions from high to low improvement potential, and supporting both offline fixed partitions and online repartitioning strategies.

modules.name: Baseline Agent Frameworks
modules.description: Implementing comparison baselines including All Text, All Code, Code Agent, and CodeSteer to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed fine-tuning and reinforcement learning approaches.

modules.name: Benchmark and OOD Evaluation
modules.description: Calculating core metrics like average success rate across train and test tasks, and evaluating out-of-distribution generalization on unseen benchmarks.

modules.name: Response Characteristics Analysis
modules.description: Analyzing emergent behaviors and response properties, including self-checking detection via a teacher model, code usage turn distribution, and response length evolution tracking during training.

modules.name: Ablation Study Orchestrator
modules.description: Configuring and executing various ablation studies, including SFT dataset design variants, warm versus cold starts, RL algorithm comparisons, and curriculum learning configuration impacts.

modules.name: Training Infrastructure and Logging
modules.description: Managing experiment configurations, logging training rewards and test scores, tracking GPU utilization, and handling model checkpointing and persistence.
